backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: Manage data exports, system snapshots, and database restoration.
backup.createDesc: Generates a full JSON snapshot of system data excluding passwords, authentication tokens, and files.
backup.createFallback: A copy you can keep off this machine.
backup.restoreDesc: Upload a previously generated JSON backup to restore system data safely.
backup.restoreNote: Records already in this database are left untouched — a restore only adds what is missing, and never deletes anything.
backup.resetDesc: Format the operational books — orders, payments, expenses, payroll, attendance and end-of-day closes. Staff accounts, the menu, settings and the audit trail are kept. This cannot be undone.
backup.resetNote: You are shown every record it would delete, and must confirm, before anything is removed.
backup.csvDesc: Download individual datasets as CSV files for reporting or external analysis.
backup.resetConfirmDesc: Every operational record is permanently deleted. Download a backup first if you might need this data again — a reset cannot be undone from this screen.
backup.restoreKeepExisting: Existing records are kept as they are; only records missing from this database are added. Newly added staff accounts arrive without passwords and will need a password reset before they can sign in.
backup.toast_download_tooBig: It is {{size}}, larger than the {{limit}} upload limit for restore. Keep it as an archive and use the database restore procedure in Runbook.md if you need to load it back.
backup.toast_download_ok: {{size}} of system data. Check your downloads folder.
backup.toast_failed_msg: Could not generate the backup. Try again.
backup.toast_tooLarge_msg: {{size}} exceeds the {{limit}} upload limit. Restore this file with the database procedure in Runbook.md instead.
backup.toast_read_msg: The file could not be opened. Try copying it to this device again.
backup.toast_json_msg: That file is not valid JSON.
backup.toast_shape_msg: The file has no "data" section. Pick a backup generated from this screen.
backup.toast_restore_failed_msg: The backup could not be applied. Nothing was changed.
backup.toast_reset_ok: {{total}} operational records removed. Staff accounts, menu, and settings were kept.
backup.toast_reset_reminders_paused: Attendance and payroll reminders are paused until tomorrow.
backup.toast_reset_failed_msg: Could not reset the system data. Nothing was deleted.
